item.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising new questions about whether today’s safety tests capture the risks of multi-agent systems.

item.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Dali Rajic will take over as OpenAI's top salesperson.

item.title: Ford on track to complete $2B factory overhaul for Fathom EV truck
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Ford expects to begin prototype builds of the Fathom EV in the first quarter of 2027.

item.title: X open sources its ranking algorithm, letting users see if they’ve been ‘shadowbanned’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: X is expanding the open source code behind its 'For You' feed and launching new transparency tools that show users when its ranking systems have affected their accounts or posts.

item.title: Instagram introduces a redesigned wordmark
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The social media giant says it was time for a sharper and more modern look after a decade.

item.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

item.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.

item.title: Who really needs a cocktail robot?
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Bartesian's cocktail makers would be best described like a Keurig or Nespresso machine, but for alcoholic drinks.

item.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments, according to the WSJ.

item.title: In a first, US will allow some private firms to carry out cyberattacks
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The new order sweeps away decades of existing U.S. cybersecurity policy prohibiting private companies from conducting 'hack back' attacks or offensive cyber operations.

item.title: Can social media start over? Bluesky’s CEO and COO deliver their case at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Bluesky CEO Toni Schneider is joined by COO Rose Wang for a Disrupt Stage session on whether social media can start over and where Bluesky fits into that potential reboot.

item.title: Some Claude users are mad that Anthropic’s new watermarks will catch them using it at their jobs, classes
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Is Anthropic's new watermarking system a travesty? Some have taken to social media to complain that it is.

item.title: AI nuclear power firm Fermi finally has a new CEO
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Lee McIntire, an independent member of Fermi's board, has been hired as CEO, more than three months since the company fired co-founder Toby Neugebauer from the top post.

item.title: Northrop’s robot space mechanic is a new way to keep satellites at work longer
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: The Mission Robotic Vehicle is making the first attempt to attach a new thruster to an aging satellite.

item.title: Amazon will train on Twitch streamers’ content by default, unless they opt out
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: "If this was opt-in, nobody would opt in," Twitch CPO Mike Minton said on a livestream responding to user feedback. "That's honestly the answer."

item.title: Grubhub’s $24M FTC settlement is finally reaching diners and drivers
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Checks are being mailed from Grubhub's $23.8 million fine from the FTC after it settled allegations over its business practices.

item.title: AI coding startup Cognition reportedly already in talks to raise at $40B valuation
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: Cognition may be looking to raise another mega round just a few months after raising $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation.

item.title: As AI safety concerns mount, three pioneers make the case for staying open
item.dc:creator: Kate Park
item.description: At Ai4, three of the world's most respected AI experts — Geoffrey Hinton, Fei-Fei Li, and Andrew Ng — debated regulation, open source access, and how America can compete as China advances in Asia.

item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings raises $2B to bring AI to the enterprise
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Thrive Holdings has raised $2 billion in new funding at a $12 billion valuation from investors like SoftBank, D1 Capital Partners, and Altimeter Capital.

item.title: Uber Freight reportedly investigating after hacking group claims data breach
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: An extortion gang known for targeting transportation companies and private equity firms has taken credit for a breach at Uber Freight.
